short_description:
Where to customize cars in GTA 6: 14 mod shops in all. In Vice City, Euroform Automotive is in Little Cuba and Rideout Customs (Ultimate Edition) is in Crosstown. For off-road builds, Port Gellhorn has Dirt Merchants in the south and Wasteland Off-Road in the north. Others: Capri Classic in Capri, Coastal Auto Care in Key Lento, Ledford Motorcycle Workshop in Grayson. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: PowerPyx, Game8.
